notes.title: Demo Version 0.6.3 Update
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo to version 0.6.3. The update details are as follows:

[Bug Fixes]

 Corrected errors in the English text.
 Corrected errors in the Simplified Chinese text.
 Fixed a bug where using the "Happy Cheese" on a piece that increases coins would reset the coin count.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.6.1 Update
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo to version 0.6.1. Here are the details of the update:

[Improvements]

 Added animation to the deck count when the deck size increases.


[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed an issue with the effects when the population increases due to a piece.
 Corrected the text displayed after clearing the demo.
 Fixed a bug where buttons could not be pressed at times.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.5.9 Update
notes.notes:
Due to a critical progression bug, we have urgently updated the demo to version 0.5.9. The update details are as follows:

[Bug Fixes]

 When no matching pieces are available, causing the game to halt, all pieces will now randomly change color to allow continuation.
 Fixed an issue where piece counts were not displaying correctly on the deck review and clear screens.


We apologize to everyone who has been eagerly awaiting the new "Buildings" feature.Development of the "Buildings" feature is still ongoing.

We will continue to update the demo. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo Version 0.5.8 Update
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo to version 0.5.8! Here are the details of the update:

[Improvements]

 Added effects when chaining puzzles.
 Improved UI effects.
 Enhanced the behavior when mousing over.
 Added new sound effects.


[Bug Fixes]
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where buttons were continuously scaling.
 Corrected a bug that prevented coins from increasing when holding over 1000 coins.
[/olist]


We will continue to update the demo. In the next update, we plan to add a new feature called "Buildings." Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo Version 0.5.6 Update
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo to version 0.5.6! Here are the details of the update:

[Improvements]

 Added a button to check the village (deck) on the piece acquisition screen.
 Added effects to the title screen.
 Automatically switches the initial language according to Steam's language settings.


[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where effects were not displaying correctly due to display resolution.
 Fixed a bug where the background music continued to play when returning to the title screen.


We will continue to update the demo. Stay tuned!

[Improvements]

 Display time and deck after clearing.

We will continue to update the demo. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo Version 0.5.4 Update
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to version 0.5.4! Here are the details of the update:

[Improvements]

 Shortened animations for pieces that only affect the player.
 Pieces that cannot use the "Bomb" item no longer glow.


[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed a bug where strawberries did not enter the village when rain and strawberry seeds were eliminated simultaneously.
 Corrected text errors with strawberry seeds.
 Fixed an issue where item sizes were changing incorrectly.
 Resolved an issue where the effect area of items remained visible.
 Corrected a bug where the display showed a deficit even when there were enough coins for the bank payment.



We will continue to update the demo.

Thanks to improvements in the game’s tempo with this update, we plan to add features for time attack in the next update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo Version 0.5.3 Update
notes.notes:
We've updated the demo to version 0.5.3! The details of the update are as follows.


 Mouse over a piece to reduce the time it takes for the description to appear.
 Add a tutorial for the clearing conditions when the population reaches 600.


We will continue to update the demo in the future. Stay tuned!
